They played their home games at the [[Allen Arena]] in [[Nashville, Tennessee]] and were led by 6th-year head coach [[Casey Alexander]]. They finished the season 29–8, 14–2 in ASUN play to finish in a share of the regular season championship with [[2018–19 Liberty Flames basketball team|Liberty]]. They defeated [[2018–19 Kennesaw State Owls men's basketball team|Kennesaw State]] and [[2018–19 NJIT Highlanders men's basketball team|NJIT]] to advance to the championship game where they lost to Liberty. As a regular season conference champion and No. 1 seed in their conference tournament who failed to win their conference tournament, they received an automatic bid to the [[2019 National Invitation Tournament|National Invitation Tournament]] where they defeated [[2018–19 Davidson Wildcats men's basketball team|Davidson]], [[2018–19 UNC Greensboro Spartans men's basketball team|UNC Greensboro]], [[2018–19 NC State Wolfpack men's basketball team|NC State]], and [[2018–19 Wichita State Shockers men's basketball team|Wichita State]] to advance to the championship game where they lost to [[2018–19 Texas Longhorns men's basketball team|Texas]]. ==Previous season== The [[2017–18 Lipscomb Bisons men's basketball team|Bisons]] finished the [[2017–18 NCAA Division I men's basketball season|2017–18 season]] 23–10, 10–4 in ASUN play to finish in second place. They defeated [[2017–18 Stetson Hatters men's basketball team|Stetson]], [[2017–18 Jacksonville Dolphins men's basketball team|Jacksonville]] and [[2017–18 Florida Gulf Coast Eagles men's basketball team|Florida Gulf Coast]] to become champions of the [[2018 Atlantic Sun men's basketball tournament|ASUN tournament]]. They earned the ASUN's automatic bid to the [[2018 NCAA Division I men's basketball tournament|NCAA tournament]] where they lost in the first round to [[2017–18 North Carolina Tar Heels men's
